# Find next with F3

Press **Ctrl+F**, type `lantern` and press **F3**: the next one is
marked. **Shift+F3** goes back to the one before. Enter and Shift+Enter do
the same from the bar, and F3 also works while the keyboard is in the text
of the editor with the bar still open.

Close the bar with Esc and press F3 again: the bar opens on the word
searched last, at the match after the one it was closed on.

The word is on this page ten times: once above, and nine times below, in
every kind of block.

## Where the word is

A paragraph with the first lantern in it, in plain text.

> A quote with the second: a *lantern* in emphasis.

- A list item with the third lantern
- An item without one
  - A nested item with the fourth, a **lantern** in strong text

| Thing | Where |
|-------|-------|

| Nothing | here |

```text
The sixth lantern is in a code block.
```

A link with the seventh: [a lantern in a link](https://example.com/light).
